correctness.rationale: Direct least-unused-letter recursion exhausts all involutions at each required order and independent Young tableau corner-growth recursion produces identical complete descent histograms. Exact Walsh transforms, direct signed character checks, and the full 64-entry order-seven spectrum establish rank 28 and precisely four extra even-frequency zeros; early ranks are 1,1,1,4,8,16,28,64. Tableau transpose proves symmetry zeros. Four exceptional frequencies have binary rank four. Group translation averaging gives a globally least-norm Fourier range projection; exact integer kernel numerator histogram 28:2,4:4,-4:2,2:16,-2:16,0:24 establishes 144/64=9/4. Surviving minimum multiplier magnitude is 8. The extracted scientific program passes 2429 assertions; no larger-order theorem is claimed.

originality.rationale: Strongly credits published, all-order prescribed descent-set enumeration (Chow 2008) and the classical tableau complement symmetry. New assessment is confined to Fourier rank, first noncontractive projection at order seven, return at eight, and globally optimal norm 9/4. Prior enumeration supplies input counts but does not state or settle those operator-theoretic conclusions. Closest published index results use other objects or different parameters. Bounded search cannot eliminate an unindexed equivalent interpretation.
residual_risks: Chow (2008) already determines every prescribed descent-set count, so independent derivations from these data must not be presented as novel enumeration.
An earlier or unindexed work may have evaluated the same Fourier nullity or optimized the same projection; the bounded indexed search and primary inspections do not prove historical uniqueness.
Scope is finite n<=8, not a conjecture or classification of all n.

value.rationale: A natural Boolean convolution derived from non-independent permutation descents has symmetry-forced recovery modes. Order seven is the first dimension where the optimal full range projection ceases to be a contraction, with exact first nontrivial extra cancellation set and sharp global endpoint amplification 9/4; order eight restores the norm-one behavior. This gives a natural first spectral stability transition and quantifies information loss, more than a bare finite table, while not pretending to give a general n classification.
